_source: Jess's Tarot Feedback Google Doc 1WsHXNJcqF0mE8xaQy6XCoBbZ-fPUDjwDpOJGWaCz-E4, read 2026-10-29. Cards marked _cowork_draft were not in her doc and were written by Cowork in the same register; Jess may replace them.

the-fool.text: You wandered into a motel parking lot on a Friday night for a hot dog and stayed for the people... that's the whole lesson. Say yes to the weird invitation this winter. The ones who look a little ridiculous are usually having the best time.

the-magician.text: Everything you need is already in the pantry, honey. Stop waiting on the perfect recipe and cook with what's in front of you. The magic lives in the nerve it took to show up wearing that costume.

the-high-priestess.tagline: Trust the gut you fed tonight
the-high-priestess.text: You know more than you're letting on. That quiet little voice that said come out tonight was right, and it'll be right again in December when everyone wants a piece of you. Keep a few evenings sacred... the soup can wait for you.

the-empress.text: This is your sign to be soft. Take the second helping and then take up the whole couch. The season is harvesting and so are you... let people pour into you for once. Plenty is a thing you're allowed to receive.

the-emperor.text: Somebody's got you. Look around this room... these are folks who will carry you when your legs go stiff in February. Build the table you want to sit at and make the rules generous. Structure is just love with good posture.

the-hierophant.text: Some rituals are worth keeping: the Sunday sauce, the same bar stool, the friend who always brings the dip. Peppers has blessed this gathering from his pillar. Pass down the recipe, and pass the plate while you're at it.

the-lovers.tagline: Curl up next to your person
the-lovers.text: Two bodies, one blanket, zero shame. Whoever you curl toward this winter, let them see you mid-yawn. Belonging shows up at your sleepiest... let it. Text the one you're thinking about right now.

the-chariot.text: You don't have to pull this year to the finish line alone. Find your other sphinx and steer together, even if one of you is clearly napping on the job. Momentum looks a lot like company.

strength.text: Real strength is showing your belly in a room full of strangers and trusting nobody's gonna poke it. You made it through a whole year... sprawl out and take up space. Gentleness is the flex, baby.

the-hermit.text: Curl up. Light one candle. The holidays are loud and you're allowed to leave the party early and call it self respect. Go deep into the quiet for a minute... then come back out and tell us what you found. We'll save you a seat.

wheel-of-fortune.tagline: What goes around comes back to the table
wheel-of-fortune.text: Up, down, belly up, belly down. The year turned on you a few times and here you are anyway, fed and in good company. Luck is just showing up enough times that the wheel lands on you... and tonight it did.

justice.text: That look you just gave your plate? Fair. Weigh things honestly this season, including what you give and what you let yourself take. Settle the beef... and forgive the dump cake for being a little messy.

the-hanged-one.tagline: Hang loose, see it upside down
the-hanged-one.text: Some seasons ask you to stop pushing and just dangle there. Let the leaves fall. Look at your whole life from the wrong angle for a minute... it's amazing what looks charming from down here. Surrender is a strategy.

death.text: Nothing scary here, just a cat asleep in the leaves. Something in you is ready to be done, and that's allowed. Let it curl up and rest. Whatever comes next is already warming up in the kitchen.

temperance.tagline: A little of this, a little of that
temperance.text: Mix the sweet with the sharp. Pour a bit of yourself into other people and let them top you back up. This winter, the magic is in the blend... old friends stirred in with the brand new ones from tonight.

the-devil.text: Order the second hot dog. The devil wears brodo tonight and so can you... a little wickedness keeps the soul warm in a season this cold. Bite into the thing you actually want. Just share the chips.

the-tower.tagline: Knock it down, keep the buns
the-tower.text: The pile was never going to stay stacked, babe. Let it fall. What's left standing after the mess is usually the part you actually needed... and there's always another hot dog.

the-star.text: The lights are coming. After a long, weird year, you get to be hopeful without apologizing for it. Let yourself want things for next year out loud. Somebody under that tree is rooting for you... probably a cat, but still.

the-moon.tagline: Not everything has to make sense yet
the-moon.text: Halloween is the one night it's fine to not know what you are. Let the fog roll in. The path gets clearer when you stop squinting at it... wear the costume, trust your night eyes, and keep walking toward the ones who feel like home.

the-sun.text: Lie down in the warm spot. Joy is just sitting there on the rug, sugar... waiting for you to roll over into it. Let the short days be bright anyway.

judgement.text: That itch you've had about a fresh start? Answer it. The end of the year is a good time to rise from the rug and say what you actually want. Forgive last year's version of you... she was doing her best with what was in the fridge.

the-world.tagline: You made it all the way around
the-world.text: Full circle and a full belly. Look at you... finishing a whole year and ending it in a motel lot with strangers who are now sort of your people. That's the world, babe. Come sit back down at the table whenever you need it.

the-pet-parade.text: Look at this crowd. Dogs in capes, cats in bandanas, people pretending they're not here for the snacks. You belong in the parade exactly as you came. March with the ridiculous ones this winter... they know where the warm porches are.

the-pass.text: Everything you've been cooking on is ready to go out. Ring the bell. Let people taste what you made this year, even the parts that came out a little messy. The pass is where the kitchen meets the room... go stand in it.

omens: a long phone call with an old friend
leaves crunching on the way home
a cat on your lap at the worst possible time
